pages.title: Entropy
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Melee Weapons$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks stack entropy marks; 2 stacks slow the target; at full stacks, detonates true damage equal to 30% of the target's lost health, and spreads.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
